"""New owner-local extraction; never edits the retained shared R5 source."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import hashlib
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = ROOT / 'source'
retained = SOURCE / 'hepta/hia_machine_plan_control_native.py'
raw = retained.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == 'd896b591af434a46c1cf3835fe851a70b59e3225cd7bbcbdecf57eb6cab601b5'
text = raw.decode()
lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
tree = ast.parse(text)
fixture = SOURCE / 'tests/fixtures/hia_public_front_transport_r5.py.txt'
fixture.write_bytes(raw)
changes = []
def replacement(node, value):
    changes.append((node.lineno-1, node.end_lineno, value))

replacement(tree.body[0], '''"""Owner-local fixed continuation transport for public-front HIA.

Extracted from the exact R5 frame transport. No retained Plan/Core policy body,
public machine-plan wrapper, source selector, or backend installation route is
present. The front owner supplies its own GLOBAL/CALL/closure/import primitives.
The inherited diagnostic strings are preserved for the retained mechanics.
"""\n''')
for node in tree.body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Import) and any(a.name == 'builtins' for a in node.names):
        replacement(node, '')
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == 'functools':
        replacement(node, '')
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == 'hia_json_preflight_native':
        replacement(node, 'from .hia_json_preflight_native import NativeHiaJsonImage\n')
    elif isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id in
            {'SOURCE','SCHEMA','SELECTOR','_PUBLIC','_HELPERS'} for t in node.targets):
        replacement(node, '')
    elif isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'installed_machine_plan':
        replacement(node, '')

frame = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'PlanFrame')
image = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'NativeMachinePlanControl')
# Only class labels change. All preserved methods retain identical ASTs.
changes += [(frame.lineno-1, frame.lineno, 'class ContinuationFrame:\n'),
            (image.lineno-1, image.lineno, 'class NativeContinuationImage(NativeHiaJsonImage):\n')]
for method in frame.body:
    if isinstance(method, ast.FunctionDef) and method.name in ('_global','_call','_function'):
        args = {'_global':'name', '_call':'args, raw', '_function':'args, raw, vector'}[method.name]
        replacement(method, '    def '+method.name+'(self, '+args+'):\n'
                    "        raise NotImplementedError('public-front owner must supply its fixed primitive')\n")
for method in image.body:
    if isinstance(method, ast.FunctionDef) and method.name in {
            'prepare','finish','run','validate','witness','code_options','preservation_checks'}:
        replacement(method, '')

for start,end,value in sorted(changes, reverse=True):
    lines[start:end] = [value]
new = ''.join(lines)
old_import = "        elif op == 19:\n            from . import hia_program\n            result = getattr(hia_program, self.image.literal(raw[0]))\n"
new_import = "        elif op == 19:\n            raise NotImplementedError('public-front owner must supply its fixed import primitive')\n"
assert new.count(old_import) == 1
new = new.replace(old_import,new_import).rstrip()+'\n'
destination = SOURCE / 'hepta/hia_public_front_transport.py'
destination.write_text(new)

bridge = SOURCE / 'hepta/hia_public_front_native.py'
bridge_before = bridge.read_bytes()
old = 'from .hia_machine_plan_control_native import (\n    PlanFrame, NativeMachinePlanControl, _Cell, _EMPTY)'
revised = bridge_before.decode().replace(old,
    'from .hia_public_front_transport import (\n    ContinuationFrame, NativeContinuationImage, _Cell, _EMPTY)')
assert revised != bridge_before.decode()
revised = revised.replace('class PublicFrontFrame(PlanFrame):',
                          'class PublicFrontFrame(ContinuationFrame):').replace(
                          'class NativePublicFront(NativeMachinePlanControl):',
                          'class NativePublicFront(NativeContinuationImage):')
bridge.write_text(revised)

new_tree = ast.parse(new)
report = {'schema':'hia.public-front.pure-transport-extraction.v80.r2',
    'source_before_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    'runtime_methods':[], 'changed_provider_hooks':['_global','_call','_function','_effect.op19'],
    'removed_image_methods':['prepare','finish','run','validate','witness','code_options','preservation_checks'],
    'shared_source_unchanged':retained.read_bytes()==raw,
    'new_native_execution':False,'old_R1_results_not_inherited':True}
for old_class,new_name in ((frame,'ContinuationFrame'),(image,'NativeContinuationImage')):
    new_class = next(n for n in new_tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name==new_name)
    originals = {n.name:n for n in old_class.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
    for method in new_class.body:
        if not isinstance(method,ast.FunctionDef): continue
        if method.name in ('_global','_call','_function'): continue
        reference = originals[method.name]
        if method.name == '_effect':
            # The sole explicit provider removal: retained IMPORT opcode must
            # never enter a backend or accidentally become an inherited policy.
            reference = ast.parse(ast.unparse(reference)).body[0]
            old_stmt = next(n for n in ast.walk(reference) if isinstance(n,ast.If)
                and ast.dump(n.test)==ast.dump(ast.parse('op == 19',mode='eval').body))
            old_stmt.body = ast.parse("raise NotImplementedError('public-front owner must supply its fixed import primitive')").body
        assert ast.dump(reference,include_attributes=False)==ast.dump(method,include_attributes=False), method.name
        report['runtime_methods'].append(new_name+'.'+method.name)
for name in ('_read_word','_capture','_capture_with_handler','_runtime_profile'):
    before = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==name)
    after = next(n for n in new_tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==name)
    assert ast.dump(before)==ast.dump(after),name
report['fixed_functions']=['_read_word','_capture','_capture_with_handler','_runtime_profile']
report['files']={}
for path in (fixture,destination,bridge):
    data=path.read_bytes()
    report['files'][path.relative_to(SOURCE).as_posix()]={
        'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        'git_blob_sha':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()}
folder=ROOT/'transport-extraction-r2';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(folder/'REPORT.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True))
